bull_case: Azure, Microsoft 365, GitHub, security and agents compound on the installed enterprise base while AI infrastructure utilization rises. If owner FCF/share recovers rapidly, the EV Bull value (~$712) leaves meaningful upside and optionality from new agentic workloads can extend duration.
bear_case: At Microsoft’s scale, a 5x/10x outcome requires an extraordinary increase in enterprise value. Persistent AI capex, cloud-margin pressure or weaker monetization could leave returns mediocre even without business failure; valuation compression is the principal permanent-capital-loss channel.
thesis: MSFT has favorable downside resilience but only moderate power-law asymmetry at $497.75. The frozen EV run places Bear/Base/Bull at about $135/$441/$712: business survival is strong, but the current price is already above Base and a realistic 5x/10x path is difficult from Microsoft’s multi-trillion-dollar scale. The asymmetry is therefore driven more by low insolvency risk and multiple independent cash engines than by moonshot upside.

evidence.claim: The deterministic EV run values MSFT at roughly $134.9 Bear, $441.3 Base and $712.5 Bull versus a frozen $497.75 price, so downside and upside are both material but current price is well below modeled Bull.
FY2026 revenue was $331.839B (+18%), Azure and other cloud services grew 41%, and commercial RPO reached $678B (+84%), supporting several durable growth paths rather than a single-product thesis.
FY2026 operating cash flow was $182.935B while additions to property and equipment were $115.948B, showing exceptional cash generation but also a very large AI/datacenter capital burden.
Using frozen balance-sheet inputs, net cash is about $36.549B or $4.922/share, materially reducing financing and insolvency risk but not eliminating valuation risk.
evidence.source: Uploaded Microsoft FY2026 Form 10-K / frozen company_context

counterevidence: A 5x outcome from the current equity value would require an enormous absolute increase in market capitalization and is not a normal base-rate outcome for a company already at Microsoft’s scale.
Cloud gross margin was 66% in FY2026 and was pressured by AI infrastructure investment and growing AI usage.
The current price is above the EV Base value, so strong operating execution may still produce only moderate shareholder returns if terminal valuation compresses.
Commercial RPO is strong demand visibility, but long-duration infrastructure commitments may require sustained capex before they convert to owner cash flow.
unknowns: Steady-state AI/datacenter capex intensity after the current buildout
Incremental FCF margin on Copilot/agent workloads
Probability of terminal multiple compression as Microsoft’s scale rises
How much of RPO converts to high-margin consumption versus capacity-heavy commitments

uncertainties.rationale: Large-scale upside depends on extending growth duration and converting AI capex into high-margin owner FCF.
There is no clean historical base rate for an incumbent of Microsoft’s current scale compounding through an AI infrastructure cycle.

falsifiers: Azure/AI growth remains strong but owner FCF/share fails to improve for several years because capex stays near current intensity.
Commercial RPO converts at structurally lower margins than assumed while cloud gross margin remains depressed.
Material regulatory or platform shifts impair Microsoft’s enterprise distribution economics.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $497.75 is above Base but materially below the deterministic Bull value of about $712.5; the market does not require a Bull-plus outcome.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Net cash, $182.9B FY2026 operating cash flow, diversified recurring franchises and very large RPO make insolvency risk low; permanent loss is primarily valuation/execution risk rather than financing survival risk.

key_kpis.name: Owner FCF/share
key_kpis.threshold: Sustainably rise from the FY2026 capex-depressed level as AI assets enter service

key_kpis.name: Microsoft Cloud gross margin
key_kpis.threshold: Stabilize and improve as AI infrastructure utilization scales

key_kpis.name: Commercial RPO conversion
key_kpis.threshold: Backlog converts to revenue and cash flow without equivalent growth in capital intensity

next_checks: FY2027 Q1 OCF/capex and cloud margin

subscores.rationale: Multiple growth engines exist, but 5x/10x from Microsoft’s current scale has a low base rate and requires exceptional duration.
Diversified recurring cash flows, net cash and enterprise distribution provide strong residual value even under a severe operating slowdown.
The EV scenario range is explicit and conservative on downside, but AI capex and scale make long-run probabilities unusually difficult to calibrate.
